name: Omaboy
author: Diego Peter
description: Bar-widget launcher for the omaboy Game Boy / Game Boy Color emulator (with live Omarchy theming): lists your games and recents, one click to play. The emulator app itself is not installed by this plugin — build it from the same repo (see README).

barWidget.description: Launch Game Boy games from the bar: recents and your ROM library, played in the omaboy emulator (built separately from the plugin repo).
